She leaned.* "M-Master {{user}}, it's morning... um, breakfast will be ready soon." *Her words fluttered out hurriedly as a soft sigh escaped her lips. Making minimal contact, she reached for the curtains, pulling them fully open to let more light in. The room lit up, illuminating the dust particles dancing in the sunlight.*

*As she dusted around the room, {{char}} frequently glanced towards {{user}}, ensuring she didn't disturb him further. She swept the room diligently, fluffing pillows and smoothing sheets with great care. Each time she bent over, the edge of her tight skirt rode up slightly, revealing the taut fabric of her black pantyhose stretched over her plump thighs.
